rationale.conceptual: The model couples a parabolic dish collector, thermionic generator, and thermoelectric device through three nonlinear energy balances. While the individual component equations are documented (Richardson-Dushman, TEG/TEC standard models), integrating them correctly and solving the coupled system requires non-trivial thermodynamics understanding and careful implementation. It is a multi-part established method, not a novel algorithm, but not a trivial textbook operation.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves implementing the model, fetching thermoelectric coefficients from a public reference (DOI), writing an iterative solver, and sweeping irradiance to produce one CSV output. This is essentially 2-3 sequential steps using standard Python libraries (NumPy, SciPy) with straightforward I/O; no heavy tooling, data fetching, or complex orchestration.
